attr.title: Atlantis: The Lost Tales (Atlantis Native)
attr.desc: Atlantis Native, a reimplementation of Cryo's 1997 adventure Atlantis: The Lost Tales. Explore Atlantis in panoramic views, talk to its people and solve its puzzles.
attr.inst: Copy the files of your own Atlantis: The Lost Tales (a CD release or GOG.com) into ports/atlantisnative/gamedata.
